projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

The sustained 23–25 device count paired with zero camera motion over the last 90 minutes indicates a settled Saturday evening gathering (likely a movie night, gaming session, or extended family/friends visiting) where occupants are stationary in non-camera zones. This aligns with normal weekend patterns and requires no action.

The sustained 23–25 device count paired with zero camera motion over 90+ minutes strongly indicates a large group is gathered indoors in a single common area, likely engaged in a stationary activity like a movie or game night. This coherent pattern confirms a normal Saturday gathering rather than a security or motion issue.

The stable 23–26 device count over two hours with zero camera motion confirms a settled, long-duration indoor gathering rather than a transient spike; no action needed, but monitor network load and ensure the dogs have a quiet retreat.

The sustained high device count (20–26) paired with zero camera activity strongly suggests a gathering is taking place in a camera-blind zone or the cameras are offline. Given the Saturday afternoon timing, this is likely a social visit or kids' friends over, but verifying camera functionality and checking blind spots is recommended.

The rapid increase from 19 to 25 connected devices in the last four minutes, paired with zero camera activity, strongly suggests unmonitored arrivals (such as guests or delivery personnel) entering the property. A quick visual check is recommended to confirm who is present.

The sustained high presence count (19–22 devices) paired with zero camera activity over the past three hours strongly suggests the camera system is offline or experiencing a reporting failure, which is particularly notable given the expected activity from children and dogs on a Saturday afternoon.

The gradual decline from 22 to 19 connected devices between 10:13 and 10:43, paired with zero camera motion, indicates devices are likely entering sleep mode or drifting to weak-signal zones rather than an active departure. This is a normal Saturday morning pattern and does not require intervention.

The presence count stabilized at 21-22 devices after the 06:50 AM fluctuation, and combined with zero camera activity over the last 2.5 hours, this confirms the household is still at home in a quiet, settled state. The initial high count likely reflects a network scan artifact, and the stable pattern rules out an early departure or unusual activity for a Saturday morning.

The connected device count dropped from 25-26 to 22 at 06:50 AM, indicating 3-4 devices disconnected. Combined with no camera activity, this may signal an early morning departure or routine device sleep mode, but is likely normal for a Saturday morning.
